interpretations: For each `transactionrecord.ordertypedist` value, including `NULL` as its own group, count the joined rows where `advancedbehavior.patsim > 0.439` and `transactionrecord.transreg = advancedbehavior.translink`.

For each `ordertypedist` value, including `NULL` as its own group, count distinct matched `transactionrecord.transreg` values for which at least one linked `advancedbehavior` record has `patsim > 0.439`.
queries:
SELECT t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM transactionrecord AS t
JOIN advancedbehavior AS a
  ON t.transreg = a.translink
WHERE a.patsim > 0.439
GROUP BY t.ordertypedist

SELECT tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg)
FROM transactionrecord AS tr
JOIN advancedbehavior AS ab ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
WHERE ab.patsim > 0.439
GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist
